rounds.text: The most compelling evidence for the bull case is the dramatic turnaround in operational efficiency, as evidenced by the quarterly operating margin surging to 21% in March 2026 from just 5% in the year-ago quarter [E24]. This 16-percentage-point expansion suggests that the company has successfully pivoted toward a significantly more profitable business model, which is not yet reflected in the trailing annual metrics [E23]. Furthermore, the company maintains a superior return on assets of 0% compared to the sector benchmark of -4.06%, demonstrating a relative resilience in asset utilization [E8]. While the long-term sales growth of 17% over five years highlights a proven ability to scale, the recent stabilization in sales growth at 1% indicates a bottoming out of the previous three-year decline [E14, E15, E16]. Conceded: [E1], [E6], [E7], [E23], [E49]. The market is currently pricing the stock based on historical stagnation, failing to account for the massive, recent inflection in quarterly profitability [E24].
